query:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    ts,
    id,
    LAG(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, id) AS prev_ts
  FROM events
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    ts,
    id,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_ts IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN ts - prev_ts > 1800 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_session
  FROM ordered
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    ts,
    SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
      PARTITION BY user_id
      ORDER BY ts, id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  session_no,
  MIN(ts) AS start_ts,
  MAX(ts) AS end_ts,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_no
ORDER BY user_id, session_no;
